[SWS_CM_11362] Execution Context for registering Setters
⌈
For the
RegisterSetHandler method described in [SWS_CM_00116] a second overload
with an additional input parameter shall be provided. This parameter shall provide an
executioner object in which RegisterSetHandler shall be invoked. The minimum
behaviour of the Execution Context is defined in [SWS_CM_11364].
template<typename ExecutorT>
ara::core::Result<void> RegisterSetHandler(
std::function<ara::core::Future<FieldType>(
const FieldType& value)> setHandler, ExecutorT&& executor);
For the first overload without an execution context argument an implementation de-
fined default execution context (like in previous AUTOSAR releases) shall be used.
⌋
